title: 第25章 帮个忙第26章 试探
slug: 漂亮后妈要翻身我在七零养崽崽
content_zh:
陆庆生笑著道：“今天医院里来了一位老首长，坐著吉普带著警备连，据说从门口到三哥的病房门口全部都是荷枪实弹。那阵势可不是一般的大。”
陆红武听的瞪大了眼睛：“那就是你三哥发达了？他的腿能治好？”
“听医生说是没问题。发达是肯定发达了，你想想，如果我三哥不发达，那老首长能来看他吗？”
陆红武鬱闷地道：“那就是说二百块钱要不回来了？”
“我三哥要是发达了，別说二百块钱，就是两千块钱他也得给咱娘。再说了，那个苏灿胖成那个样子，三哥的腿一旦恢復了，怎么可能看上她？到时候根本不用咱们自己动手，那个苏灿就得灰溜溜滚出陆家。”
这样一听，陆红武的心里顿时有种解气的感觉。
“哈哈，你说的对呀。这个臭娘们儿怎么看都不顺眼，行，那就让她先好好伺候伺候你三哥。这种免费的劳力不用白不用。”
“对，不管怎么说，咱们跟三哥是打断骨头连著筋的。所以这事你暂时不用操心了，这几天医院这边我盯著。你先回村吧。”
“行，这样的话我就放心了。”
……
因为是两条腿受伤，有一条腿中了两枪，所以这台手术做了三个小时。
下午一点多的时候，陆战东终於被推出了手术室，因为打了麻药，所以他还在昏迷当中。
不过他还是被送去了之前的那个单间，院长告诉苏灿，在他们没有办理出院手续之前，都一直住在这里。而且接下来所有的费用，全都是免费的。
能有单间住，还是免费医疗，再加上之前的那些补助，这可不是一般的待遇。
还有那个萧老首长来的时候那个阵仗，苏灿严重怀疑，陆战东不是临阵逃脱，而是立了大功的英雄。
不过既然他不愿意说，她也就不问了。
医生告诉苏灿，陆战东在医院的时间取决於他的恢復情况，目前来看在半个月左右。
让苏灿意外的是，陆战东被送回病房的时候，隨行的人里多了个兵哥哥。
而且正是那个赵铁柱。
一问才知道，他是老首长特意留下来，帮忙照顾陆战东的。

现在有人帮忙，苏灿自然不能让周大爷和周青山一直陪在这里。
去医院食堂买午餐的时候，她特意多买了几个馒头和肉菜，吃不了的就让他们带回去。
爷俩走的时候，苏灿送他们到了楼下，各拿出了二十块钱给他们。
周大爷和周青山说什么也不要。
苏灿看著他们道：“周大爷，青山，其实我是想让你们帮我个忙。”
“侄媳妇，你说吧，什么忙？”
“就是，嫂子，咱们乡里乡亲的，帮忙是应该的。”
苏灿道：“那我就不客气了。你们也知道我们家那三个孩子穿的都是破衣烂衫的，老二脚上连双鞋都没有。我想拜託周大爷，明天能不能麻烦您再跑一趟，把他们兄妹三人送到医院里来？
一来让他们看看陆战东，二来我想带他们买点衣服鞋子啥的。”
周大爷有马车，虽然时间慢一些，但是这也算个不错的交通工具了。
content_en:
Lu Qingsheng said with a smile: "Today, an old chief came to the hospital, riding in a jeep with a security company. It is said that from the door to the door of the third brother's ward, everyone was loaded with live ammunition. The formation was not ordinary."
Lu Hongwu's eyes widened when he heard this: "So your third brother has developed? Can his legs be cured?"
"I heard from the doctor that there is no problem. If he is developed, he must be developed. Think about it, if my third brother is not developed, can the old chief come to see him?"
Lu Hongwu said depressedly: "Does that mean we won't get the two hundred yuan back?"
"If my third brother gets rich, not to mention two hundred yuan, but even two thousand yuan, he will have to give it to my mother. Besides, that Su Can is so fat. Once my third brother's legs recover, how can he fall in love with her? Then we won't have to do anything ourselves, and that Su Can will have to get out of the Lu family in despair."
Upon hearing this, Lu Hongwu suddenly felt relieved.
"Haha, you're right. I don't like this stinky bitch no matter what. Okay, let her serve your third brother well first. This kind of free labor does not go to waste."
"Yes, no matter what, we and the third brother broke bones and connected tendons. So you don't have to worry about this for now. I'll keep an eye on the hospital these days. You can go back to the village first."
"Okay, that way I'll feel relieved."
…
Because two legs were injured and one leg was shot twice, the operation lasted three hours.
At around one o'clock in the afternoon, Lu Zhandong was finally pushed out of the operating room. He was still in a coma because of the anesthesia.
However, he was still sent to the previous single room. The dean told Su Can that he would stay here until they went through the discharge procedures. And all subsequent fees are free.
Being able to live in a single room and get free medical care, coupled with the previous subsidies, this is not an ordinary treatment.
There was also the battle when Chief Xiao came. Su Can seriously doubted that Lu Zhandong did not escape from the battle, but was a hero who made great achievements.
But since he didn't want to say it, she stopped asking.
The doctor told Su Can that Lu Zhandong's time in the hospital depends on his recovery, which is currently about half a month.
To Su Can's surprise, when Lu Zhandong was sent back to the ward, there was a soldier brother among the people accompanying him.
And it was that Zhao Tiezhu.
After asking, I found out that he was left here specifically by the old chief to help take care of Lu Zhandong.
Now that someone is helping, Su Can naturally can't let Uncle Zhou and Zhou Qingshan stay here all the time.
When she went to the hospital cafeteria to buy lunch, she deliberately bought a few more steamed buns and meat dishes, and asked them to take them back if she couldn't eat them.
When the two men left, Su Can sent them downstairs and gave them twenty yuan each.
Uncle Zhou and Zhou Qingshan said nothing.
Su Can looked at them and said, "Uncle Zhou, Qingshan, actually I want you to do me a favor."
"Niece-in-law, tell me, what are you busy with?"
"That's right, sister-in-law, we fellow villagers should help."
Su Can said: "Then I'm not polite. You also know that the three children in our family are all wearing rags, and the second one doesn't even have a pair of shoes on his feet. I would like to ask Uncle Zhou, can you please make another trip tomorrow to send the three brothers and sisters to the hospital?"
Firstly, let them see Lu Zhandong, and secondly, I want to take them to buy some clothes and shoes. "
Uncle Zhou has a carriage. Although the time is slower, it is still a good means of transportation.
